label: dense baseline feature (boosted by n/i/v in original phase)
explanation: Active on 93.8% of all steps and every sequence, with flat rates (0.87-1.0) across phase, position, L, input/output token and history variables; the trivial predicate t >= 0 already gives F1 0.97, so binary firing carries no selective structure. It is slightly less active at the delimiter (0.89) and at copy recall_idx 0-3 (~0.89). Magnitude has structure: the largest activations (up to 6.5) occur in the original phase once the tokens n, i or v have been input (often repeated, e.g. v n n n), building up across those tokens and decaying afterwards and into the copy phase. The predicate (phase==0) & (n/i/v seen or current) has precision 0.99 and covers 48% of top-quartile activations, with magnitude correlation 0.53, but only 17% recall. Sequences without n/i/v show low uniform activations (~0.1-0.3 of max).
